xsd_support.description: Provides a more powerful and extensible schema language than DTDs, supporting data typing, namespaces, complex element/attribute constraints, and inheritance.
xsd_support.xsd_example: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <xs:element name="person"> <xs:complexType> <xs:sequence> <xs:element name="name" type="xs:string"/> <xs:element name="age" type="xs:integer"/> </xs:sequence> </xs:complexType> </xs:element> </xs:schema>

c14n_support.description: Produces a normalized, deterministic representation of an XML document, essential for consistent signature verification and comparison.

features.feature: Deterministic representation for consistent signature verification
Canonical form eliminates whitespace and attribute order variations
Supports both exclusive and inclusive canonicalization methods
Essential for XML Digital Signature standards (XMLDSig)

c14n_support.c14n_example: <!-- Example of canonical XML output (simplified) --> <root> <element attr1="value1" attr2="value2"> <child>text</child> </element> </root>
